# snipeit_field (Data Source)

Looks up a custom field by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_field" "mac_address" {
  name = "MAC Address"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the field.
- `name` (String) Name of the field.

### Read-Only

- `db_column_name` (String) Generated database column name of the field.
- `element` (String) Form element type of the field.
- `field_values` (String) Selectable values, one per line.
- `format` (String) Validation format of the field.
